wing_name: Log Erased (No Account Recorded) After an Admin Sign-in (Behaviour)
description: One person signs in with administrator rights and, within one hour, a Windows event log is erased by an account the log did not record (System log 104: the parsed record keeps no subject). UBA rules: privileged_logon then log_cleared (only clears with no account). An erase the Security log attributes (1102) is covered by 'Log Clearing After an Admin Sign-in'. Windows setup erases the logs too: a hit at the install time is expected.
proves: A Windows event log was erased soon after a person signed in as an administrator
author: Crow-Eye Team
